data.name: The Dark Plague : Trials Of Galwefeld
data.detailed_description:
In an endless, pitch-black forest where shadows hide deadly secrets, survival hangs by a thread. Dark Plague is a tense horror game plunging you into total darkness, where one wrong move seals your fate.

Remain undetected

Stealth is essential. Armed only with a lantern, evade nightmarish horrors in the shadows. Tread silently, hide wisely, and extinguish your light to avoid detection in tense pursuits.

You are infected

The plague spreads within you. Time is short, find the cure deep in the forest or face permanent death, with no second chances.

Keep your wits

The darkness assaults your mind with apparitions, echoes, and illusions that test your sanity. Stay sharp to separate reality from madness, or fall into fatal traps.

Crafting for Survival

Scavenge for ingredients like mushrooms and herbs, then brew decoctions to slow the plague, boost mental resistance, and aid you in the darkness.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Horror: Navigate pure darkness where light is both ally and enemy.

  • Survival Crafting: Brew remedies to manage sanity, plague buildup, and stamina.

  • Stealth Tactics: Outwit horrors with environment and wits.

  • Replayability: Procedural generated forest, and randomized rewards.

Dare to face the Dark Plague? Wishlist now, your cure awaits, if you survive.

data.short_description: Dark Plague is a top-down, horror, stealth, roguelite. Navigate the pitch black forest with only your lantern. Don't get detected, forage for ingredients, craft decoctions to keep the plague under control, and aid you in the darkness. Navigate deep into the woods to find a cure, or perish forever.
